ticket: I am so incredibly sorry to bother you this late, but our executive director is panicking because the new state compliance auditor just demanded immediate proof of our data retention policies for all volunteer records, and I honestly don't know which settings in Northbeam control the audit logs or how to pull a comprehensive export of every data point we've stored for our donors and project members to satisfy this GDPR-style request before the deadline tomorrow morning; I know this isn't a bug or an outage, and I feel terrible interrupting your team during what looks like a quiet evening, but could you please guide me on how to generate a full data export and deletion log for our entire organization? We have been using Northbeam for years and we are usually very good at following up on things, but this regulatory requirement came out of nowhere and I am just terrified we are going to be non-compliant because I can't find the right section in the help docs to extract this specific historical data access information.
SSO users locked out after IdP config change. Only affects one admin though. Team can still login via direct URL. Also, the export button on the dashboard is laggy. Please fix the access issue ASAP.
